newsitem.title: ROMANIA: FURNITURE MAKER JOINS BUCHAREST STOCK EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: FURNITURE MAKER JOINS BUCHAREST STOCK EXCHANGE.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse said on Wednesday a state-run furniture maker would join in trading on Thursday, bringing to 38 the total number of listings.
Newcomer Stratusmob SA would trade on the second tier, an exchange statement said.
It said the company, based in Blaj in the Transylvania region, had a share capital of 23.8 billion lei, in shares with a nominal value of 1,000 lei each.
The State Ownership Fund is the main shareholder of Stratusmob, with a stake of 51.9 percent. Other stockholders, including company staff, have the rest.
The Bucharest stock exchange now trades 37 companies. Four are listed on the first tier. ($=7,087 lei)
